title: Trusting Allah with an Uncertain Future
paragraphs: Saat kelulusannya mendekat tanpa prospek pekerjaan konkret yang tersusun, Salma merasa semakin cemas menyaksikan beberapa teman sekelasnya mendapatkan posisi sementara lamarannya sendiri berulang kali tidak dijawab selama berminggu-minggu. Ayahnya mengingatkannya pada prinsip yang ia andalkan sepanjang kariernya sendiri: bahwa usaha yang wajar dikombinasikan dengan kepercayaan yang tulus pada rencana Allah lebih penting daripada secara obsesif mengendalikan setiap kemungkinan hasil.

Perspektif ini tidak sepenuhnya menghilangkan ketidakpastiannya, tapi memungkinkannya terus melamar secara metodis alih-alih terperosok dalam keputusasaan yang membuat usaha produktif semakin sulit dipertahankan. Delapan bulan setelah kelulusan, jauh lebih lama dari yang awalnya ia harapkan, Salma mendapatkan posisi yang pada akhirnya jauh lebih cocok untuknya daripada peluang yang awalnya ia kejar dengan begitu cemas.
answerKey: As her graduation approached without any concrete job prospects lined up, Salma felt increasingly anxious watching several classmates secure positions while her own applications repeatedly went unanswered for weeks at a time. Her father reminded her of a principle he had relied on throughout his own career: that reasonable effort combined with sincere trust in Allah's plan mattered more than obsessively controlling every possible outcome. This perspective did not eliminate her uncertainty entirely, but it allowed her to continue applying methodically rather than spiraling into the kind of despair that made productive effort increasingly difficult to sustain. Eight months after graduation, considerably longer than she had originally hoped, Salma secured a position that ultimately suited her far better than the opportunities she had initially pursued so anxiously.
